blocks.text: One motion form for the chair and the head, kept while the room is open: after publishing it is filled in, its button reads Update motion, and the gold action moves to Fill ballot (Edit ballot once the ballot is in). Only the room page's top bar is gold. Prep is stored by cab as one end time per room (room_preps.ends_at): publishing sets now + 15 min, the same time keeps it, a new time moves it. Everyone else reads the motion read-only with the countdown.
